# Skoci — Ultra-lightweight Agent-Native Deployment Platform
> Self-hosted deploy platform: AI agents deploy, humans validate via dashboard, apps run on user VPS.

## Key Facts
- Single Rust binary (<20MB idle RAM target)
- Zero shell string interpolation (safe against prompt injection)
- CLI & MCP tools return structured JSON with {code, message, fix} error format
- Secrets are encrypted at rest with node keys and never returned to model context
- Production actions require human approval

## Agent Workflow
1. Initialize: `skoci init` detects framework, creates `skoci.yaml` & `Dockerfile`
2. Configure: Add domain and environment variable names (not secret values)
3. Set Secrets: `skoci secret set <KEY> <VALUE>` (encrypted on host)
4. Deploy to Preview: `skoci deploy --env preview`
5. Verify: Check health check & smoke test in output
6. Request Production Promotion: `skoci promote "<reason>"` (returns request ID for human approval)
7. Check Status & Logs: `skoci status` and `skoci logs`

## CLI Commands
- `skoci init [--app <name>]`
- `skoci deploy [--env preview|production] [--force]`
- `skoci status [<app>]`
- `skoci logs [<app>] [--tail 100]`
- `skoci secret set <KEY> <VALUE>`
- `skoci secret list`
- `skoci rollback [<version>]`
- `skoci promote "<reason>"`
- `skoci doctor`
- `skoci db backup <service>`
- `skoci db restore <service> <backup_id>`

## MCP Tools
MCP server provides:
- `skoci_init`, `skoci_deploy`, `skoci_status`, `skoci_logs`
- `skoci_secret_set`, `skoci_secret_list`
- `skoci_rollback`, `skoci_promote`, `skoci_doctor`
- `skoci_db_backup`, `skoci_db_restore`
Note: `approve` and `upgrade` are strictly restricted to humans.
